answer: Proof of useful work serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to expend computational resources to validate transactions. This economic barrier prevents an attacker from fabricating a fable of independent identities. By tethering influence to actual energy consumption, the system ensures that the cost to spoof identities remains at a perpetual nadir of profitability, while the network remains as sturdy as cedar against malicious fragmentation and duplicate agent inflation.
